title: Hollywood North Experience Tour In Toronto
includes: Toronto Local Guide-A Film Industry Professional! (Actors, Directors etc.)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Tour duration is travel time included
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Visit real-life locations from Suicide Squad, Suits, The Boys, Handmaid’s Tale, Degrassi, American Psycho, Saw Vii, X-Men, Flashpoint, Rookie Blue, Chicago, Cinderella Man, The Umbrella Academy, The Vow, among many many others.

Join this unique 2.5-hour walking tour showcasing Toronto’s booming Film and TV industry while exploring iconic landmarks and neighborhoods. Perfect for film fans, history buffs, and architecture fans of all ages.

Stand where famous scenes were filmed, watch clips on a tablet, and learn how Toronto transforms into cities around the world.

Led by a local actor, see key landmarks like David Pecaut Square, Union Station, Canada’s Walk of Fame, outside CN Tower, City Hall, Nathan Phillips Square, Eaton Centre and Yonge-Dundas Square. Discover the city’s history, architecture, and vibrant role in film through interactive activities and behind-the-scenes insights.

Perfect for tourists, locals, and anyone curious about the ever-growing film industry in Toronto.
